title: Docs: rationale doc, What/Why sidebars, de-AI the guides
description: Mark 2026-10-23: the guides read like AI text and need a clear what and why. (3) Rewrite prose in docs/guide-regulars.md, guide-captains.md, guide-anchors.md, flag-day.md, vouching.md per ~/TASKS/styleguide-scrub-ai.md (Larry mode): lead with the task, test-harness note to a footer, no 'cast:'/setup filler, no hedges/fake transitions, every sentence carries weight. Command blocks byte-identical and in order (tests/migrate/test_guide_regulars.py and tests/patatt/test_patch_docs.py run them). Fold in vouch-b03j. Start after the follow-up workflow wf_b0a543ae-4f7 finishes (it holds these files).
acceptance_criteria: rationale.md exists, every entry cites DESIGN.md; each guide section has a What/Why sidebar; command blocks unchanged (diff of extracted blocks empty); doc tests green on 3.12 and 3.9; an independent reviewer pass against styleguide-scrub-ai.md finds no AI tells.
